games.description: Sark explores Dreamcore’s five large maps across several solo visits. He escapes the pools, navigates the neighborhood and hotel, works through the playrooms’ generator maze, and tours the dead mall; the playrooms remain unfinished when he leaves them for another visit.
games.title: Dreamcore

games.description: A solo campaign through a strange facility built around reversed time, recovered bullets, drones and a second persona. Sark initially stalls at the safe puzzle, returns after working out its count, and pushes through the remaining combat and puzzles to the abrupt ending.
games.title: Ethereal Abyss

games.description: An anomaly hunt that begins with Nogla, Terroriser and Vanoss and continues solo. Sark learns the marking tool, clears the observation-room route, then returns to tackle the larger office map, its dangerous challenges, and the final level-nine exit.
games.title: Exit Together

games.description: A completed solo anomaly-spotting run through the hotel’s parking-garage map. Sark struggles with the controls and head bob, studies the supposedly changing environment, and reaches the exit on Hard without identifying a single anomaly.
games.title: Exit16: Byilhan Hotel

games.description: Sark meets a cast of survivors, solves item puzzles and fights through a rough-running story before returning for Sam and the ending.
games.title: The Backrooms: Forsaken
